steps.title: Check database inclusion
steps.description: Search the Beneficiary Identification System at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or mera.pmjay.gov.in using mobile number, Aadhaar, or ration card to see if the household is in the SECC 2011/RSBY database.
steps.user_friendly_description: Go online and check if your family is already on the government's list.

steps.title: Complete e-KYC
steps.description: If included, complete Aadhaar-based (or non-Aadhaar) e-KYC to generate the Ayushman Card.
steps.user_friendly_description: Verify your identity (usually with Aadhaar) to get your card generated.

steps.title: Assisted registration (if needed)
steps.description: Visit a Common Service Centre (CSC) or an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra help desk for assisted verification and card generation.
steps.user_friendly_description: If you need help, visit a Common Service Centre or the help desk at an empanelled hospital.

VAYVANDANA.official_helpline: 14555 (general PM-JAY helpline); 1800-11-0770 (reported Vay Vandana support line - LOW confidence, unverified against a primary source)

steps.title: Confirm age 70+
steps.description: Confirm the senior citizen's age is 70 or above as recorded in Aadhaar.
steps.user_friendly_description: Make sure the Aadhaar record correctly shows an age of 70 or above.

steps.title: Complete Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Complete mandatory Aadhaar-based e-KYC via the Ayushman App or beneficiary.nha.gov.in, or with assistance at a CSC/empanelled hospital.
steps.user_friendly_description: Do the Aadhaar identity check online or get help at a nearby centre.

steps.title: Choose scheme if already covered elsewhere
steps.description: If already covered under CGHS/ECHS/Ayushman CAPF, make the required one-time choice between the existing scheme and AB-PMJAY during enrolment.
steps.user_friendly_description: If you already have CGHS, ECHS, or CAPF coverage, you'll be asked to pick one during enrolment.

steps.title: Receive Ayushman Vay Vandana card
steps.description: Once verification is complete, the Ayushman Vay Vandana card is issued.
steps.user_friendly_description: You'll get your senior-citizen health card once everything is verified.

steps.title: Confirm eligibility category and residence
steps.description: Confirm you fall into a notified CGHS-eligible category and reside in a CGHS-covered city.
steps.user_friendly_description: Check that your job/pensioner status and your city of residence both qualify.

steps.title: Fill application at official portal
steps.description: Fill the CGHS card application at the official portal.
steps.user_friendly_description: Fill in the online CGHS application form.

steps.title: Submit printed application with documents at Wellness Centre
steps.description: Print the completed application and submit it, with supporting documents, at a CGHS Wellness Centre (open Monday-Saturday, typically 7:30 AM-2:00 PM, closed on Central Government holidays) for verification.
steps.user_friendly_description: Print your form and take it, with your documents, to a CGHS centre for checking - this process is not fully paperless.

ESIC.official_helpline: 1800-11-2526 / 1800-11-3839 (numbers referenced in the context of ESIC/PM-JAY convergence on nha.gov.in) - MEDIUM confidence, recommend reconfirming on esic.gov.in

steps.title: Employer registers the establishment
steps.description: The employer registers the establishment with ESIC online (Form 1, with PAN, address proof, registration certificate, and employee list) within 15 days of the Act becoming applicable.
steps.user_friendly_description: Your employer is responsible for registering the workplace with ESIC - this isn't something an individual employee does alone.

steps.title: ESIC issues code number and employee insurance number
steps.description: ESIC issues a code number to the establishment and each covered employee receives an insurance number / Pehchan card.
steps.user_friendly_description: Once registered, you get your own ESI insurance number and card.

CMCHIS.official_application_url: NOT_CONFIRMED - commonly cited as cmchistn.gov.in but this could not be independently verified as live/authoritative in this research pass
CMCHIS.official_helpline: Reported Tamil-language toll-free support line and contact emails (tnhealthinsurance@gmail.com, cmchis@uiic.co.in) - LOW confidence, sourced only from a Government-of-India aggregator, not the scheme's own portal

steps.title: Obtain income certificate
steps.description: Obtain an income certificate from the Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or Revenue authorities.
steps.user_friendly_description: Get an income certificate from your local VAO or revenue office.

steps.title: Gather documents and visit enrolment centre
steps.description: Gather Aadhaar card, ration/family card, and income certificate, then visit the designated enrolment centre.
steps.user_friendly_description: Take your Aadhaar, ration card, and income certificate to the enrolment centre.

steps.title: Verification and biometric capture
steps.description: Present documents for verification; complete fingerprint and eye scan and have a photograph taken.
steps.user_friendly_description: Your documents are checked and your fingerprints, eye scan, and photo are taken.

steps.title: Receive CMCHIS e-card
steps.description: Once verified, the CMCHIS e-card is issued.
steps.user_friendly_description: You get your CMCHIS health card once everything checks out.
